items.title_en: Fourteen killed in Myanmar military air strikes on monastery
items.summary_en: Fourteen people were killed in military air strikes at a monastery in Myanmar's central Sagaing region, opposition fighters and a local rescue worker said. Civilians had gathered at the site for a meditation retreat, and the site was struck twice as rescuers searched for survivors. Myanmar has been locked in civil war since the military staged a coup in 2021.
items.title_zh: 緬甸軍方空襲寺院釀14死
items.summary_zh: 反抗軍與當地救援人員表示，緬甸中部實皆省一座寺院遭軍方空襲，造成14人喪生。當時平民正聚集在該地參加禪修活動，救援人員搜救時該處又遭第二次轟炸。緬甸自2021年軍方政變以來便深陷內戰。

items.title_en: Carney calls Trump's fresh tariffs a 'miscalculation' after trade talks collapse
items.summary_en: US-Canada trade talks collapsed late on Friday, prompting new 50% US tariffs covering about $20bn of Canadian imports including wine and dairy. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said Canada will retaliate 'reluctantly' and match US tariffs dollar-for-dollar from 8 September. The collapse comes amid a mandatory review of the USMCA pact, which underpins $1.6tn in annual trilateral trade.
items.title_zh: 美加貿易談判破局 卡尼批川普新關稅是「誤判」
items.summary_zh: 美加貿易談判於週五深夜破局，美國隨即對約200億美元的加拿大進口商品加徵50%新關稅，涵蓋葡萄酒與乳製品等。加拿大總理卡尼表示將「不情願地」反制，自9月8日起對美國關稅採取一比一等額報復。談判破局正值《美墨加協定》強制性審查期間，該協定支撐每年1.6兆美元的三邊貿易。

items.title_en: Chou Tien-chen falls to Kodai Naraoka in BWF Worlds semi-final, takes bronze
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Chou Tien-chen lost 21-17, 11-21, 10-21 to Japan's Kodai Naraoka in the BWF World Championships men's singles semi-final, missing his first-ever final. The 36-year-old takes home bronze, his second World Championships medal and a record for a Taiwanese men's singles player. His world ranking is expected to rise to No. 4.
items.title_zh: 【後續】周天成4強遭奈良岡功大逆轉 摘世錦賽銅牌寫台灣男單紀錄
items.summary_zh: 繼前日晉級4強確保獎牌後，周天成在世錦賽男單準決賽以21比17、11比21、10比21遭日本好手奈良岡功大逆轉，無緣生涯首度闖進決賽。36歲的他收下銅牌，這是他生涯第2面世錦賽獎牌，也締造台灣男單第1人紀錄。他的世界排名預計將升上第4名。
